news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Receives FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for LX2020 for the Treatment of PKP2 Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy
news.summary: The FDA granted RMAT designation to LX2020, Lexeo's AAV-based gene therapy for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, based on positive interim data from the HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial. LX2020 now holds RMAT, Orphan Drug, and Fast Track designations, positioning it for closer, more frequent FDA engagement ahead of a registrational study.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Raised to "Strong-Buy" at Chardan Capital
news.summary: Chardan Capital upgraded Lexeo Therapeutics from Buy to Strong-Buy, reflecting growing analyst confidence in the LX2006 registrational program following June's regulatory and trial-design update. The upgrade added to a string of bullish sell-side calls on the stock over the summer.

news.headline: JPMorgan Lowers Lexeo Therapeutics Price Target to $9 from $12, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: JPMorgan trimmed its price target on LXEO to $9 from $12 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing an updated valuation model that still implies significant upside from the then-current share price. The revision followed Lexeo's finalized SUNRISE-FA 2 pivotal trial protocol.

news.headline: Lexeo Shareholders Reelect Directors, Ratify KPMG Auditor
news.summary: At its virtual 2026 annual meeting, Lexeo stockholders reelected three Class III directors, including CEO R. Nolan Townsend, to serve through 2029 and ratified KPMG LLP as the company's independent auditor for fiscal 2026.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Publication in JAMA Cardiology of Phase I/II Data for LX2006 in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Lexeo announced that Phase I/II data on its LX2006 gene therapy in 17 patients with Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy were published in JAMA Cardiology, showing sustained cardiac and neurologic improvements, favorable biomarker changes, and a generally well-tolerated safety profile through up to 36 months of follow-up. The publication reinforces the clinical rationale behind the therapy's advancement into a registrational study.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Update and Registrational Trial Design for LX2006 Gene Therapy in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Lexeo finalized the protocol and statistical analysis plan for its SUNRISE-FA 2 pivotal trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy, an open-label study of high-dose LX2006 versus an untreated control arm intended to support a BLA submission under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway in 2028. Shares jumped roughly 13% on the news as enrollment was set to begin by the end of June 2026.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Lexeo is expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and provide an operational/pipeline update in mid-to-late August 2026.

catalysts.label: LX2020 12-month high-dose data update
catalysts.detail: Lexeo has guided to a 12-month data update for all high-dose participants in the HEROIC-PKP2 trial of LX2020 gene therapy for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, now supported by the new RMAT designation.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA 2 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the pivotal SUNRISE-FA 2 trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy are expected in the second half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Planned BLA submission for LX2006
catalysts.detail: Lexeo intends to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 under the accelerated approval pathway in the first half of 2028, based on SUNRISE-FA 2 pivotal data.

pulse: Lexeo Therapeutics enters August 2026 on a run of positive regulatory and clinical newsflow: the FDA granted RMAT designation to its second cardiac gene therapy candidate, LX2020 for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, on August 5, while lead program LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy is now enrolling in the pivotal SUNRISE-FA 2 trial following a finalized trial design and supportive Phase I/II data published in JAMA Cardiology. Sell-side sentiment has grown more constructive over the summer, with Chardan Capital upgrading shares to Strong-Buy in late July even as JPMorgan trimmed its price target to $9 on a June valuation update, against a backdrop of roughly $227.6 million in cash providing runway into 2028. The next scheduled catalyst is the Q2 2026 earnings update expected in mid-to-late August, followed by a Q4 2026 LX2020 data update and a SUNRISE-FA 2 topline readout targeted for the second half of 2027 ahead of a planned 2028 BLA submission.
